cap:info.cap:headline: River Jalaka at Mathani Road Bridge in Balasore district of Odisha continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 6:00 am today.
cap:info.cap:description: River Jalaka at Mathani Road Bridge in Balasore district of Odisha continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 6:00 am today. At 6:00 am, it was flowing at a level of 6.04 m with rising trend which is 0.04 m above its Warning Level of 6 m and 0.46 m below its Danger Level of 6.5 m.

cap:area.cap:areaDesc: Jalaka, Mathani Road Bridge, Balasore, Odisha
